Available tools:
- scrape_web_page: Web Page Scrapping (beta). Get all images and anchors found in a web page
- ocr_image_to_text: Provided by OCRLy.biz, this image to text processor is very accurate and used by IT teams to convert images of error screenshots to text in their zendesk accounts for example.. Provide the image url a
- update_canned_message: Stay closer to your customers and answer their questions faster with LiveAgent.. Updates canned message

I need to refresh our customer support canned response with the new specs from this vendor announcement: https://vendor-updates.tech/specs/model-x-2024. Since the details are in an image on that page, please extract the text and push it live to our system.
The page scrape succeeded and located the specification image and a PDF download link. I will now extract the text from the image to proceed with updating the support canned response.

The OCR tool successfully extracted the specification text from the image with a confidence score of 0.9845. This data is ready for the support update, so I will now format these specifications and proceed to push them to the system.
